fire_product.business_question: How many detected thermal anomalies intersect each configured AOI per UTC day?
fire_product.grain: AOI / UTC date; overlapping AOIs may count a detection more than once
fire_product.data_nature: real/open FIRMS observations; derived aggregates; curated reference AOIs

time_coverage.schema_version_kind: sha256-field-names-v1; not a declared schema contract

representative_query.purpose: Review the largest AOI/day detection counts; not a hazard confirmation.
representative_query.sql: SET schema = 'serving'; SELECT aoi_key, date_key, detections, mean_frp, max_frp FROM serving_wildfire_daily ORDER BY detections DESC, aoi_key, date_key LIMIT 5

limitations: Domain owner has not approved grain, completeness bounds, or an acceptance scenario.
AOI seed is curated rectangular reference data, not independently verified EMS activation evidence.
Unmatched detections remain in the attribution ledger; no AOI is invented to improve match rate.
Matching uses WGS84 lon/lat, outer edges included, hole interiors/edges excluded; no reprojection, antimeridian polygons, temporal activation matching, or burned-area inference.
Brightness is VIIRS I4 or MODIS channel-21/22 temperature (K), not interchangeable radiance; FRP (MW) and confidence remain independent. Confidence categories use the existing numeric mapping.
A successful snapshot is a bounded observation window, not a transactional whole-lake snapshot.

No credentials, source URIs, station/vessel payloads or raw records are emitted. Recent landing is evidence of prior access, not a live upstream probe. Unsupported objects and unknown time ranges are explicit. Source mappings are non-additive.
